title: Godly Speech
definition: Godly Speech is the use of words in ways that honor God, tell truth, build others up, and reflect a renewed heart.
summary: Godly Speech is the use of words to tell truth, give grace, restrain evil, and build others up before God.
christFocus: Jesus Christ speaks truth and grace, and He teaches His disciples to use words for life rather than destruction.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on the tongue as an instrument of discipleship or destruction. Words can bless, wound, deceive, heal, complain, flatter, gossip, pray, and proclaim Christ. Godly speech brings the mouth under the lordship of Jesus.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because speech often reveals the heart before we realize it. Churches, homes, and friendships are strengthened or damaged by words. This doctrine calls believers to truthfulness, gentleness, restraint, courage, and encouragement.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pause before speaking when anger or pride is strong. Replace gossip with prayer, flattery with honest encouragement, and harshness with truth in love. Ask God to make your words useful for grace.
